coordinate_convention.rect: x,y,width,height; pixel edges; no inclusive endpoint
coordinate_convention.pivot: Body cell pivot is always [164,128]. Standard living head is [164,90]. Crouch and death have an intentionally moving head reference.

code_reference.pattern_order: Starts normal, then shuffled groups without immediate repeats. shuffle_patterns=False uses barrage -> normal -> homing -> laser.

normal_parry.animation_trigger: single shot at state entry, then idle

homing_parry.animation_trigger: single shot at state entry, then idle

authoring.visual_alignment: Fixed cell pivot [164,128]. Standard living head reference [164,90]. Crouch lowers the head intentionally while ground contact stays at y=228. Head widths normalized to approximately 76px. Hand-drawn contours retain small differences.
authoring.sockets: Per-frame cell-local visual attachment points on the colored contour. Six barrage attachment points sample six successive vertical contour bands. socket_usage identifies firing states. Existing code world spawn_rules remain recorded separately.
authoring.integration: Art and metadata package. Current code removes the boss immediately on death, so a future integration must keep a visual actor alive to play and hold death.
authoring.parry_colors: Ordinary bullet and missile assets are plum. Reward projectile variants require pink for doodle and sky blue for eraser at integration. They are not supplied as separate variants in this package.
authoring.effects: Independent effects reused from the preceding pencil-style package. The body and representative poses use the new purple octopus design.

crouch.integration: Optional art states. Enter plays once then crouch_idle loops. Exit reuses enter frames in reverse then returns to idle. No gameplay state or collision changes.
